thread:
sam_user: I signed up minutes ago, finished email verify, added card via Apple Pay (looks like 3DS ok) but didn't get free trial credits. Account: acct_0x9f3a. PM token: pm_7a1b. Region in console shows GB but I'm in US. Any ideas?
maya_support: sorry about that, we'll check. Do you have the last4 or payment method id? Can you DM if you prefer. Also did you click the verify link before adding card?
sam_user: last4 4242, pm id pm_7a1b. I clicked verify first, then added card, 3DS completed. Payment gateway returned `authentication_success`.
payments-bot: autogrant_attempt report: event_id=evt_202603171045, account=acct_0x9f3a, pm_id=pm_7a1b, autogrant_result=denied, reason="bin_country_mismatch", bin_country=NL, ip_country=US, email_domain=company.co (catch-all), flow=v2
devin_payments: thanks for the info — looks like bin country (NL) != detected IP country (US) so the autogrant service flagged it. Could be a virtual card or proxy. Two paths: (1) manual grant from support, (2) rerun autogrant with override after manual review. If you want to try quick fix maya, run:
```bash
adminctl grants create --account acct_0x9f3a --amount 100 --grant_type=signup_trial --reason "manual override: 3DS auth + email verify" --actor maya_support
```
then run rerun:
```bash
adminctl autogrant rerun --event evt_202603171045 --override-bin-check --actor devin_payments
```
maya_support: I'll run the manual grant now and paste tx id here.
maya_support: grant_tx=grant_20260317_88b, ran rerun (override) as requested. Please confirm credits appear for you in ~60s.
sam_user: saw the +100 credits, thanks! any notes on how this happened so I don't hit it again?
devin_payments: likely a virtual card issued in EU routed via NL BIN while your IP/email suggest US; autogrant conservative check blocks to prevent abuse. We'll add a ticket to payments to surface more granular UA/bin signals in the autogrant logs to reduce false positives.
maya_support: thanks everyone :tada: closing this thread once we confirm no other outstanding issues.
